# Legacy Knowledge Base Overview

This page was created under the v0.1 format and needs migration to OKF v0.2.
It uses the legacy `timestamp` field instead of `generated`, and stores its
citations in a body section rather than frontmatter.

## Background

The knowledge base started as a simple collection of markdown notes in Obsidian.
Over time, it grew to include structured frontmatter and cross-references between
concepts, entities, and skills.

## Key Principles

- Knowledge should be interconnected, not siloed.
- Every claim should trace back to a source.
- The format should be portable across tools.

## Citations

- Original OKF v0.1 specification draft — defined the initial frontmatter schema
- Personal knowledge management best practices (2023) — inspired the category system
- "How to Build a Second Brain" by Tiago Forte — influenced the progressive summarization approach
